classes.name: Antimuscarinics for overactive bladder
classes.description: Oxybutynin IR/ER/patch/gel, tolterodine IR/ER, solifenacin, darifenacin, trospium IR/ER, fesoterodine (Toviaz).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill to calm an overactive bladder.

classes.name: Beta-3 agonists for overactive bladder
classes.description: Mirabegron (Myrbetriq, generic mirabegron ER) and vibegron (Gemtesa).
classes.plainDescription: A newer daily bladder pill with fewer dry-mouth and memory side effects.

preferredAgent.sig: Extended-release: 5-10 mg once daily; increase by 5 mg weekly to max 30 mg/day (label).
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for an overactive bladder.

records.verificationNote: Read from Reference tool p.19 (07/01/2026). The PDL lists 'oxybutynin' without dosage-form detail, and the thera intro says drug names cover all forms unless noted, so the ER form is covered; 5 mg daily chosen as the once-daily generic. Strength and sig are label dosing, not printed.

preferredAgent.sig: 25 mg once daily; may increase to 50 mg after 4 to 8 weeks (label).

records.boglNote: Plan lists Myrbetriq as a preferred brand with no PA; generic mirabegron ER requires PA (p.19). AB-rating of generic mirabegron ER to Myrbetriq is from FDA product knowledge, not from the PDL.

paRequired.reason: Generic mirabegron requires PA (p.19; thera doc agrees)

records.verificationNote: Read from Reference tool p.19: Myrbetriq is in the Preferred Brand column with no PA; generic mirabegron is in the PA column. The thera doc (04/01/2026) says the same. Brand-over-generic preference is why boglActive is true. Vibegron is PA. Sig is label dosing, not printed. [Sonnet check 2026-11-02: PDL wording confirmed: Thera p.2 reads "Myrbetriq - All covered generics (generic mirabegron requires a PA)"; Ref p.19 puts Myrbetriq in the preferred-brand column (x=32) and generic mirabegron in the PA column (x=404). Same form (ER tablet); generic mirabegron ER tablets are AB-rated to Myrbetriq per FDA Orange Book (from drug knowledge, not the PDL), so boglActive true is kept.]

preferredAgent.sig: Immediate-release: 5 mg two to three times daily; max 5 mg four times daily (label).
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill two or three times a day.
